## Reviewer checklist

- [ ] The change is linked to an Issue or its scope is small and fully explained.
- [ ] Failure, cancellation, retry, and cache behavior were considered where relevant.
- [ ] Tests demonstrate the changed behavior rather than only implementation details.
- [ ] The PR does not claim unperformed manual acceptance or release evidence.
